run_evolution: run the evolution loop for prompt optimization with LLM-based instruction generation and scoring
gen_meta_prompt: generate a meta prompt for instruction rewriting given old instructions, scores, and few-shot exemplars
gen_ins_and_score_pairs_substr: generate a formatted string of instruction-score pairs filtered by threshold and score buckets
parse_tag_content: parse text content between custom prefix and suffix tags using regex
extract_string_in_square_brackets: extract the first string enclosed in square brackets from input text
